name: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Ltd.
business_summary: Research-led pharma with generics, branded and OTC business across 80 countries. Approximate mix (model knowledge): India ~42%, North America ~25%, Europe ~13%, rest of world (Latin America, Africa, Asia) ~20%. Value is increasingly tied to the innovation arm Ichnos Glenmark Innovation (IGI): trispecific antibody ISB 2001 licensed to AbbVie in 2025 (terms from model knowledge: ~US$700m upfront, up to US$1.9bn milestones; pack P&L shows large swings, e.g. Sep-25 PAT -Rs 739 cr, Jun-26 PAT Rs 736 cr, consistent with lumpy licensing and exceptional items). Latest reported quarter in the pack is Jun-26: sales Rs 2,435 cr, EBITDA Rs 613 cr (25%), PAT Rs 736 cr. Q2 FY27 results pending (trading window closed 2026-09-28). Mcap Rs 70,483 cr, P/E 48, stock +36% in 12m.

revenue_mix.segment: Rest of world and emerging markets

exposures.mechanism: Goa facility received EIR with VAI status on 2026-09-23 (Business Standard/Business Today) - de-risks a key US-supply site and was one of the catalysts for the recent run (+10.5% in 3m). Remaining sites (Baddi, Indore, Monroe NC) retain tail risk. 15% OAI probability x -14% equity, plus fewer approvals -> -3.5 per stricter unit.

evidence.note: Glenmark Goa facility gets EIR with VAI status (Business Standard 2026-09-23)

exposures.mechanism: US ~25% of sales, ~Rs 530 cr/qtr, of which Ryaltris/ branded ~20%; +5pp erosion on generics base -> -3% -> -0.6% group sales; 100% drop-through at 22% OPM = -2.7% EBITDA; EV/MCap 1.02, persistence 0.5 -> -1.4; plus gRevlimid-style and nasal-spray competition (fluticasone approval 2026-08-20 is a launch, not threat) -> -3.0 incl. multiple.

evidence.note: US FDA approval for fluticasone nasal spray in US$295m market (Sahi 2026-08-20)

exposures.mechanism: USD/EUR/EM-linked sales ~55%; imported RM ~12%; net 43% x 3% = +1.3% of sales at 11-25% OPM (TTM 11% depressed; use normalised 20%) = +6.5% EBITDA; unhedged ~60% -> +3.9%; EV/MCap 1.02, persistence 0.5 -> +2.0; plus licensing receipts in USD -> +3.0. Empirical +3.87 (t=2.4), the only |t|>2 factor; model slightly lower.
Europe ~13% of sales; +1pp demand growth -> +0.13pp group sales... plus hospital/ branded Ryaltris adoption -> +0.8.

evidence.note: Ryaltris launches in Brazil and European markets (HDFC Sky 2026-09-11)

exposures.mechanism: Latin America/Africa/Asia ~20% of sales; +1pp growth -> +0.2% sales -> +1% EBITDA (high margin), persistence 0.5; Ryaltris Brazil -> +1.2.

evidence.note: Glenmark launches Ryaltris allergy nasal spray in Brazil (HDFC Sky 2026-09-11)

exposures.mechanism: India ~42% of sales, dermatology/respiratory/cardio brands; acute & OTC discretionary-sensitive; +5pp urban -> +1.5pp India = +0.63% group sales, 60% flow-through at 20% OPM = +1.9% EBITDA; EV/MCap 1.02, persistence 0.5 -> +1.0; multiple effect -> +1.3.
Net debt small (interest Rs 23 cr/qtr); discount-rate effect on 48x P/E -> -1.2 per +25bp.

evidence.note: Interest Rs 23 cr in Jun-26 quarter (screener.in)

exposures.mechanism: FII 21.5% rising, DII 17.6% falling; promoters 46.65%. +US$5bn flows -> +1.0.

US 100% branded tariff since 2026-09-29 exempts India's speciality drugs; Ryaltris/branded US sales are made in India (exempt for now) and generics outside scope. 10% probability of broad tariff -> -0.8.
